Class PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessor.RelatedStripeTransaction

@TestVisible
private class PaymentAuthorizationPostProcessor.RelatedStripeTransaction

Wrapper class that holds the relationship data between a StripeTransaction__c and its PaymentAuthorization__c. Uses builder pattern for setting properties and provides method to convert to StripeTransaction__c for DML operations.
